comment: The two clock jacks are given no range because any signal crossing zero will do as a clock; the two clock outputs are squares whose rate is set by the clocks and are explicitly not one volt per octave. Both CV jacks for the clocks are normalled to the signal itself, so their attenuators double as audio-rate modulation depths when nothing is patched. configBypass passes the signal input to the recovered output. The module is after Schlappi Engineering's Interstellar Radio of 2018, rebuilt from the published description of its parts, a synchronous voltage-to-frequency converter and a phase-locked loop, rather than from a schematic. The panel prints aether, in, level, type, tone, cv, carrier, error, demod, cv twice, clk twice, tx, rx, mix, out, error and mix.
